block.scp_unleashed.scp1762_box.tooltip: An old cardboard shoebox. HERE BE DRAGONS, says the lid, in careful marker.
An old cardboard shoebox. Someone has corrected the words on the lid.
block.scp_unleashed.scp1762_box.detail.0: Something rustles inside when you hold it still.
block.scp_unleashed.scp1762_box.detail.1: Lift the lid somewhere with room to fly.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp1762_note.0.0: Thou hast said it. We heard thee.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp1762_note.0.1: Long we kept the edges of the maps, where the ink gave out.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp1762_note.0.2: None hath drawn a new coast for us in many a year.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp1762_note.0.3: We flew for an empty room and knew it not.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp1762_note.0.4: Ye have our thanks. Now we may rest.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp1762_note.1.0: This is the last of us.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp1762_note.1.1: We go now past the sea's end, where no map reacheth.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp1762_note.1.2: Keep the box. It held us warm through the long sleep.
gui.scp_unleashed.scp1762_note.1.3: Fare thee well. Think on us when a map runs out.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp1762_box.1: SCP-1762, Here Be Dragons, is an old cardboard shoebox with HERE BE DRAGONS written across the lid.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp1762_box.2: Lift the lid and paper dragons pour out to fly, perch and crawl close by. They are harmless, and nothing can harm them. The lid will not go back on until they are ready.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp1762_box.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-1762 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A courier will bring the box to you.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp1762.0: The courier brings the shoebox by hand, holding the lid down.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp1762.1: Open it with room to fly. Mind the lamps.
subtitles.scp_unleashed.scp1762_home: Paper dragon slips into the box
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.title: Here Be Dragons
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.caption: SCP-1762 at intake with its lid on. The lettering is original.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.0.text.0: SCP-1762 is kept in a standard storage locker on a low shelf with its lid on. It requires no maintenance.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.0.text.1: Openings take place in a cleared test room at least twenty metres across, with every light fitting caged. Video of each opening is to be kept. **SCP-1762-2 instances are not to be removed from the test room.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.0.text.2: Personnel are reminded that instances cannot be harmed and are not to be swatted at.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.1.text.0: SCP-1762 is a cardboard shoebox about thirty centimetres long with a separate lid. HERE BE DRAGONS is written across the lid in black marker in a careful, childlike hand. A faded printed band runs around the sides. The box has resisted every attempt to date it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.1.text.1: When the lid is lifted, folded paper dragons designated SCP-1762-2 emerge from the box over a few seconds. Instances are folded from ordinary paper of many colours. Four forms have been catalogued: two-legged wyverns, long legless wyrms, small four-legged drakes and four-legged winged dragons.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.1.text.2: Instances fly, glide, chase one another, perch on furniture and crawl across the floor. They never stray more than about ten metres from SCP-1762. They often land beside personnel and look up at them for long periods.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.1.text.3: The lid cannot be replaced for a minute or two after opening. When this period ends the instances spiral back into the box one at a time and the lid settles on its own.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.2.title: Addendum 1762-1: Test Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.2.text.0: Test 1762-03: Researcher Okafor tried to replace the lid early. It would not move, and the box rattled until she let go. All instances returned when the period ended.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.2.text.1: Test 1762-05: A wyvern instance struck by a thrown pencil folded its wings and fluttered behind a filing cabinet. It was undamaged and returned with the others.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.2.text.2: Test 1762-07: Twenty-six instances were counted. One drake spent the whole opening sitting on Dr. Hale's shoe.
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.3.title: Addendum 1762-2: Observations
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.3.text: Several observers have independently described the instances as waiting. Dr. Hale noted that they look up whenever someone in the room speaks, as if each sentence might be the one they have been waiting to hear. %rFurther notes withheld at the request of the research team.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.4.title: Addendum 1762-3: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.1762.page.4.text: SCP-1762 has no recovery record. It was delivered to a reader of this file. See field notes.
